unit_operations.title: 1. HDS Reactor (R-101)
unit_operations.description: Hydrodesulfurization ZnO guard bed R-101 fed by E-101 at 400 C, 44.5 bar.
streams_in: Natural Gas Feed (37,211 Nm3/h, 400 C, 44.5 bar)
streams_out: Desulfurized NG (37,211 Nm3/h, 400 C, 44.5 bar)

unit_operations.title: 2. Adiabatic Pre-Reformer (R-102)
unit_operations.description: Adiabatic Pre-Reformer R-102 fed by M-101 + E-102 converting C2+ heavies at 504 C, 38.9 bar.
streams_in: Mixed NG + Steam via M-101/E-102 (144,200 Nm3/h, 504 C, 38.9 bar)
streams_out: Pre-Reformed Gas to E-103 (144,200 Nm3/h, 504 C, 38.9 bar)

unit_operations.title: 3. Primary SMR Furnace (B-101 / R-103)
unit_operations.description: Terrace-wall radiant SMR furnace executing endothermic reforming (CH4 + H2O <-> CO + 3H2) at 900 C, 38 bar with convection coil bank.
streams_in: Pre-Reformed Gas (144,200 Nm3/h Wet, 490 C, 30 bar)
streams_out: Reformed Syngas (210,800 Nm3/h Wet / 138,500 Dry, 850 C, 28 bar)

unit_operations.title: 4. Waste Heat Boiler (E-105)
unit_operations.description: Cooling reformed syngas from 900 C to 370 C while generating high-pressure superheated steam.
streams_in: Hot Syngas from F-201 (210,800 Nm3/h Wet, 850 C)
streams_out: Cooled Syngas (210,800 Nm3/h Wet, 350 C)
HP Superheated Steam (~48.5 MW)

unit_operations.title: R-104 High-Temp Reactor Bed 1
unit_operations.description: High-temperature (380 C) and low-temperature (210 C) Water-Gas Shift reactors converting CO + H2O <-> CO2 + H2.
streams_in: Cooled Syngas (210,800 Nm3/h Wet, 350 C)
streams_out: Shifted Syngas (210,800 Nm3/h Wet / 170,200 Dry, 136,364 Nm3/h H2, 80.1% Dry H2)

unit_operations.title: E-106 Reactor Intercooler
unit_operations.description: Inter-bed steam/BFW cooler (380 C -> 210 C, Q=15.05 MW).
streams_in: Bed 1 Effluent (380 C)
streams_out: Cooled Bed 2 Feed (210 C)

unit_operations.title: R-105 Low-Temp Reactor Bed 2
unit_operations.description: High-temperature (380 C) and low-temperature (210 C) Water-Gas Shift reactors converting CO + H2O <-> CO2 + H2.
streams_in: Cooled Syngas (210,800 Nm3/h Wet, 350 C)
streams_out: Shifted Syngas (210,800 Nm3/h Wet / 170,200 Dry, 136,364 Nm3/h H2, 80.1% Dry H2)

unit_operations.title: E-107 BFW Economizer
unit_operations.description: Process heat recovery economizer (210 C -> 120 C, Q=6.43 MW).
streams_in: Hot Effluent (210 C)
streams_out: Pre-Cooled Gas (120 C)

unit_operations.title: E-108 Final Trim Cooler
unit_operations.description: Cooling water trim condenser (120 C -> 40 C, Q=5.72 MW).
streams_in: Pre-Cooled Gas (120 C)
streams_out: Condensed Gas (40 C)

unit_operations.title: 6. Syngas Cooling & KO Drum (S-101)
unit_operations.description: Cooling shifted syngas to 40 C and flashing process condensate in knockout separator S-101.
streams_in: Shifted Wet Syngas (210,800 Nm3/h Wet, 210 C)
streams_out: Dry Shifted Syngas (170,200 Nm3/h Dry, 40 C, 80.1% H2)
Process Condensate (40,600 Nm3/h vapor removed)

unit_operations.title: 4-Bed PSA Skid (V-101)
unit_operations.description: 4-bed cyclic Pressure Swing Adsorption skid purifying H2 to 99.99% at 27 C, 33.1 bar with tail gas recycle to B-101 burners.
streams_in: CO2-Lean Syngas (139,700 Nm3/h Dry, 136,364 Nm3/h H2)
streams_out: Purified H2 Product (120,000 Nm3/h Dry, 99.99% Purity)
PSA Tail Gas Recycle (19,700 Nm3/h -> F-201 Burners)

unit_operations.title: H2 Compressor (C-101..103) & 400 bar Storage
unit_operations.description: Multi-stage reciprocating H2 compressor pressurizing 99.99% pure H2 from 33.1 bar to 400 bar with interstage cooling.
streams_in: Purified H2 (120,000 Nm3/h Dry, 24 bar)
streams_out: Compressed H2 Storage (120,000 Nm3/h Dry, 400 bar, 99.99% H2)

smr_reaction_enthalpy.source_snippet: Endothermic steam methane reforming reaction CH4 + H2O <-> CO + 3H2 has standard enthalpy dH_298 = 206 kJ/mol.

wgs_reaction_enthalpy.source_snippet: Exothermic water-gas shift reaction CO + H2O <-> CO2 + H2 has standard enthalpy dH_298 = -41 kJ/mol.

smr_steam_to_carbon_ratio.source_snippet: Industrial SMR primary reformers typically operate at a steam-to-carbon molar ratio S/C = 3.0 to prevent coking.

smr_reformer_outlet_temperature.source_snippet: Primary reformer syngas outlet temperature is maintained between 850 and 900 C at equilibrium.

smr_operating_pressure.source_snippet: Modern industrial steam methane reforming plants operate at 25-30 bar pressure in the primary reformer.

psa_hydrogen_recovery.source_snippet: Pressure swing adsorption (PSA) achieves 85-90% H2 recovery at 99%+ product purity with tail gas recycle.

X_exit <= X_eq(T_out, P) and delta_T_ad <= max_adiabatic_rise_c
